title: Use treemap in languim
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This pull request refactors the `Treemap` parser by replacing the `TreemapDoc` type with `Treemap` across the codebase. The changes ensure consistency in naming and simplify the parser's type system. Key updates include modifications to the AST, validation logic, exports, and test cases.
